""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen = set() # Track unique functions # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (most structured) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen: seen.add(name) # Get description from next dd element desc = "No description found" dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: # Get first paragraph or direct text p = dd.find("p") desc = p.get_text(strip=True) if p else dd.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": block.get_text(strip=True), "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(block.get_text(strip=True)), }) # 2. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen: seen.add(name) # Try to find description in next sibling or parent's next sibling desc = "No description found" parent = block.parent if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name == "p": desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen: seen.add(name) # Get description from next paragraph desc = "No description found" next_p = block.find_next("p") if next_p: desc = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) return functions[:25] def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Extract parameter information from a function signature.""" params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string.strip(): param_parts = [p.strip() for p in param_string.split(",") if p.strip()] for part in param_parts: # Extract name, type, and default name = part.split(":")[0].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = "unknown" default = None # Check for type annotation (name: type) if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part if type_part else "unknown" # Check for default value if "=" in part: default = part.split("=")[-1].strip() if name and name not in ["self", "cls"]: params.append({ "name": name, "type": param_type, "default": default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """Format extracted documentation into a readable string.""" output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: param_info = f" - {param['name']}" if param.get('type') and param['type'] != 'unknown': param_info += f" ({param['type']})" if param.get('default'): param_info += f" = {param['default']}" output.append(param_info) output.append("") return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
